draft.weaknessQuote: Coverage issues in 2018 forced him to safety.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.14, the 105th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 8th of 21 at S. He went 85th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 60 tackles in 2019, 18th of 21 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the New Orleans Saints. 67 career games and 63 starts over 6 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (1st percentile). Played 1 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-6 safety who played: 6.0% season snap share against a median of 64.8%, below the norm.
